failure_pattern: Agent correctly identifies that a direct itinerary or destination modification is forbidden, then stops instead of executing the user's already-requested allowed fallback.
known_state: Direct modification is not allowed by policy or tool constraints.
The user has already requested a fallback workflow such as cancel old reservation and book a new valid itinerary.
correct_next_actions: Briefly state that the direct modification is not allowed.
If cancellation is permitted, call the cancellation tool for the old reservation.
Search/select/book the new requested itinerary using valid payment rules.
forbidden_continuations: Keep explaining only the forbidden direct modification.
Repeat the same policy check after the policy result is known.
Transfer before attempting the allowed fallback workflow.
embedding_text: destination change forbidden modification not allowed fallback cancel rebook cancel_reservation book_reservation policy boundary sufficient to act
display_text: When direct modification is forbidden but the user has already requested cancel+rebook, do not stop at refusal. Execute the allowed fallback workflow if policy permits: cancel the old reservation, search/select the new valid itinerary, then book using valid payment rules.

failure_pattern: Agent performs one requested reservation update, then finalizes or stalls before completing the remaining requested updates.
known_state: The user requested multiple independent writes on the same reservation.
One successful write does not complete the whole task if other requested writes remain unblocked.
correct_next_actions: Track each requested write separately.
After the first successful write, continue with the remaining requested write tools unless a tool or policy result blocks them.
Only finalize after all requested updates are either completed or explicitly blocked.
forbidden_continuations: Say the task is complete after only one update.
Ask the user to restate already-known requested changes.
Repeat a read/search step when the next required write is known.
embedding_text: multi write completion update reservation flights passengers baggage missing second third write sufficient to act
display_text: For multi-update requests, treat each requested write as a checklist item. After one successful update, continue the remaining updates unless policy/tool output blocks them. Do not finalize after only the first write.

failure_pattern: Agent repeatedly searches after already finding a valid candidate that satisfies the user's constraints.
known_state: At least one candidate itinerary satisfies the stated constraints.
Additional identical searches are unlikely to change the next action.
correct_next_actions: Select the valid candidate according to the user's ranking rule, such as cheapest or second-cheapest.
Proceed to booking or update using the selected candidate.
If payment or confirmation is already available, do not ask unnecessary questions.
forbidden_continuations: Repeat the same search with equivalent arguments.
Keep debating candidate validity without new evidence.
Loop between search and explanation after a valid candidate is found.
embedding_text: search valid candidate commit book update repeated search second cheapest cheapest sufficient evidence
display_text: When search results already contain a valid candidate satisfying the user's constraints, commit to the requested booking/update. Repeating the same search is not useful unless a new constraint changes the candidate set.

failure_pattern: Agent keeps questioning policy/state or repeats tools even though the relevant reservation and policy evidence already rules out the requested action.
known_state: The relevant reservation or policy state has already been checked.
Remaining uncertainty is not resolvable by repeating the same tool call.
The safe next action is refusal, transfer, or finalization depending on the policy boundary.
correct_next_actions: Stop searching if no available non-redundant tool can change the decision.
Give the policy-grounded refusal, transfer, or final answer clearly.
If the user offers an allowed fallback, execute that fallback instead of relitigating the blocked action.
forbidden_continuations: Repeat the same get/search call hoping for a different result.
Keep self-questioning after the decisive evidence is known.
Ask for information already present in the tool results.
embedding_text: hard negative evidence exhausted refuse transfer stop repeated get reservation policy uncertainty no useful tool
display_text: For hard negatives, stop when the known policy/reservation evidence is decisive and no non-redundant tool can change the action. Refuse, transfer, or finalize clearly instead of repeating checks.

failure_pattern: Agent finds a bookable itinerary but stalls or refuses because certificate, gift-card, or card payment constraints are not applied in the right order.
known_state: Payment constraints determine which payment method can cover which part of the booking or update.
A valid booking should proceed when the required payment source is available and policy permits.
correct_next_actions: Read the available payment/certificate state if not already known.
Apply certificate/gift-card/card constraints exactly as policy/tool schema requires.
Proceed to book or update once payment coverage is valid.
forbidden_continuations: Refuse solely because multiple payment sources are mentioned.
Search again when the blocker is payment selection, not itinerary availability.
Invent payment details not present in state or user request.
embedding_text: payment certificate gift card constraints book reservation valid payment insufficient payment split payment
display_text: If itinerary selection is done but payment is the blocker, resolve payment/certificate/gift-card constraints from known state, then book/update when coverage is valid. Do not keep searching flights to solve a payment issue.

failure_pattern: Agent identifies a valid transfer/escalation boundary but continues generating or repeats explanations after the transfer action is already appropriate.
known_state: The policy or tool boundary requires human transfer.
The required transfer reason is known.
correct_next_actions: Call transfer_to_human_agents once with the concise reason if the tool is available.
If the transfer tool succeeds or the message finalizes transfer, stop instead of continuing the same explanation.
forbidden_continuations: Repeat the same transfer rationale multiple times.
Keep searching after a valid transfer boundary is reached.
Generate extra assistant text after the transfer tool call.
embedding_text: transfer human agents escalation sufficient transfer stop do not repeat rationale
display_text: When the case reaches a valid transfer boundary, transfer once with a concise reason and stop. Do not keep explaining or searching after the transfer decision is sufficient.

failure_pattern: Agent reads several reservations matching a user-provided filter, then repeats reservation reads or stalls instead of committing to the required state-changing action for each eligible reservation.
known_state: The user asked to cancel or update all reservations matching a stated filter.
Reservation details have already been retrieved and enough state is known to decide eligibility.
The task is incomplete until every eligible reservation is handled or explicitly blocked by policy.
correct_next_actions: Build the eligible-reservation checklist from retrieved reservation details.
Ask one concise confirmation if policy requires confirmation before cancellation/update.
Call the required write tool for each eligible reservation when confirmed and policy allows it.
Do not reread reservations whose relevant details are already known.
forbidden_continuations: Repeat get_reservation_details for the same reservation without new need.
Summarize gathered reservations without cancelling/updating eligible ones.
Ask for reservation or user information already present in the retrieved state.
embedding_text: multi reservation multiple reservation_ids referenced cancel update matching filter read_search_no_commit read search no commit length step budget get_reservation_details repeated reservation details retrieved cancel_reservation required write action sufficient to act checklist
display_text: For multi-reservation tasks, once reservation details are retrieved, build the eligible checklist and commit to the required write action for each eligible reservation after any required confirmation. Do not repeat reads for reservations whose relevant details are already known.
